surfaces.raw_operation: Extern C symbol declarations for retained HAL, CMSIS, FreeRTOS, and Buddy runtime entrypoints.
surfaces.invariant: Every imported symbol must have one stable ABI owner, an exact C signature, and no Rust-side aliasing or lifetime claim stronger than the foreign implementation can uphold.
surfaces.safe_facade: Typed FFI module that exposes only narrow safe wrappers after symbol, calling-convention, and ownership checks.
surfaces.test_or_static_check: local manifest/static/Rust checks validate symbol names and wrapper shape; simulator-flow or hardware-smoke evidence is required before runtime calls are treated as proven.

surfaces.raw_operation: Reads linker-provided memory region, stack, heap, vector, and retained-section symbols from STM32F4, STM32G0, and STM32H503 linker scripts.
surfaces.invariant: Rust may only interpret linker symbols as addresses or ranges after alignment, ordering, and non-overlap checks match the selected board profile.
surfaces.safe_facade: Linker region facade that returns typed address ranges and rejects overlapping or misaligned regions during manifest/static validation.
surfaces.test_or_static_check: local manifest/static/Rust checks compare expected section names to retained scripts; hardware-only placement behavior remains manual-hardware-required.

surfaces.raw_operation: Delegates reset, vector-table, boot/noboot, and exception-startup contracts to retained startup assembly and board scripts.
surfaces.invariant: The selected board profile must bind exactly one startup source and one linker profile before Rust startup code installs or references vectors.
surfaces.safe_facade: Startup profile facade that names the retained startup owner and exposes only validated vector metadata to Rust.
surfaces.test_or_static_check: local manifest/static/Rust checks cover profile selection; simulator-flow and hardware-smoke evidence are required for reset and exception behavior.

surfaces.raw_operation: References retained STM32F4, STM32G0, and STM32H503 PLL, SysTick, and FreeRTOS clock configuration.
surfaces.invariant: Rust must treat src/device/stm32f4/core_init.cpp, src/device/stm32f4/cmsis.cpp, src/device/stm32g0/core_init.cpp, src/device/stm32g0/cmsis.cpp, src/puppy/xbuddy_extension/cmsis.cpp, and src/puppy/xbuddy_extension/hal_clock.cpp as hardware-owned until configCPU_CLOCK_HZ and fpv5-sp-d16 board facts are proven by non-local evidence.
surfaces.safe_facade: Clock contract facade that records selected board clock facts without mutating hardware clocks in Phase 5 Plan 01.
surfaces.test_or_static_check: local manifest/static/Rust checks verify source coverage only; MCU clock behavior requires hardware-smoke or manual-hardware-required evidence.

surfaces.raw_operation: Performs volatile reads and writes of peripheral registers owned by STM32 HAL/CMSIS and board code.
surfaces.invariant: Every register access must be volatile, width-correct, aligned, scoped to the selected MCU, and sequenced according to the retained HAL contract.
surfaces.safe_facade: Typed MMIO register facade that centralizes volatile access and requires board-profile proof before exposing peripheral blocks.
surfaces.test_or_static_check: local manifest/static/Rust checks can prove facade shape; actual peripheral side effects require hardware-smoke.

surfaces.raw_operation: Shares buffers between Rust-owned memory and retained DMA-capable peripherals.
surfaces.invariant: DMA buffers must remain pinned, aligned, cache-coherent where applicable, exclusive for mutation, and alive until transfer completion.
surfaces.safe_facade: DMA buffer facade that requires static or scoped ownership tokens and exposes completion before reuse.
surfaces.test_or_static_check: local manifest/static/Rust checks validate ownership API shape; DMA timing and coherence remain simulator-flow or hardware-smoke evidence.

surfaces.raw_operation: Registers, enables, disables, and dispatches retained interrupt handlers and Rust adapter callbacks.
surfaces.invariant: Interrupt callbacks must be Send-safe by construction, ISR-safe, non-blocking unless explicitly allowed, and installed only after vector ownership is known.
surfaces.safe_facade: Interrupt registration facade that restricts callback capabilities and records IRQ ownership.
surfaces.test_or_static_check: local manifest/static/Rust checks cover callback traits; interrupt priority and dispatch behavior require simulator-flow and hardware-smoke.

surfaces.raw_operation: Provides FreeRTOS static idle, timer, and task memory for retained scheduler startup.
surfaces.invariant: Static task buffers must be uniquely owned, correctly aligned, sized for the selected FreeRTOSConfig.h, and never reused for a second task.
surfaces.safe_facade: Static task memory facade that represents task storage as single-use typed cells.
surfaces.test_or_static_check: local manifest/static/Rust checks compare facade coverage to include/stm32f4_hal/FreeRTOSConfig.h, include/stm32g0_hal/FreeRTOSConfig.h, and src/puppy/xbuddy_extension/config/FreeRTOSConfig.h.

surfaces.raw_operation: Binds Rust allocation behavior to firmware heap limits and retained linker-provided regions.
surfaces.invariant: Allocator setup must be single-shot, bounded by linker-provided heap symbols, non-overlapping with stacks/static task memory, and observable as failure instead of silent memory corruption.
surfaces.safe_facade: Allocator facade that centralizes heap initialization and returns allocation errors through explicit Rust APIs where possible.
surfaces.test_or_static_check: local manifest/static/Rust checks validate linker region references; heap exhaustion and fragmentation require simulator-flow or hardware-smoke evidence.

surfaces.raw_operation: Routes Rust panic, retained assert, bsod, and fatal_error behavior through one firmware-fatal boundary.
surfaces.invariant: Panic paths must not allocate, must preserve crash evidence, and must converge on the retained user-visible fatal path instead of continuing execution.
surfaces.safe_facade: Panic boundary facade that maps Rust panic metadata to retained firmware-fatal reporting.
surfaces.test_or_static_check: local manifest/static/Rust checks verify no ordinary control-flow API exposes this path as recoverable; manual-hardware-required evidence remains for display/reset effects.

surfaces.raw_operation: Accesses retained global runtime state, linker-backed static regions, and C/C++ mutable singletons.
surfaces.invariant: Mutable statics must be isolated behind initialization-state or synchronization proofs and must not be exposed as unconstrained Rust references.
surfaces.safe_facade: Global-state facade that returns guarded handles instead of raw mutable references.
surfaces.test_or_static_check: local manifest/static/Rust checks verify only adapter modules hold mutable-static access.

surfaces.raw_operation: Reads and writes retained crash dump memory owned by src/common/crash_dump/dump.cpp and linker-provided regions.
surfaces.invariant: Crash dump memory must be accessed only during fatal or recovery flows, preserve retained layout, and avoid corrupting evidence before transfer or reset.
surfaces.safe_facade: Crash dump facade that exposes bounded records and explicit fatal/recovery states.
surfaces.test_or_static_check: local manifest/static/Rust checks cover layout ownership; actual reset-retention behavior requires simulator-flow or manual-hardware-required evidence.

surfaces.raw_operation: Observes and signals retained TaskDeps readiness from include/tasks.hpp, src/common/tasks.cpp, and task startup code.
surfaces.invariant: A task may publish readiness once, dependencies must not be observed as ready before initialization, and shutdown/fatal paths must not deadlock on readiness waits.
surfaces.safe_facade: Task readiness facade that encodes dependency states and single-publication semantics.
surfaces.test_or_static_check: rust-host-test can cover state-machine rules; scheduler timing and startup interleaving require simulator-flow.

surfaces.raw_operation: Creates, sends, receives, and destroys FreeRTOS queues through retained wrappers.
surfaces.invariant: Queue item size, ownership transfer, ISR-vs-task context, and timeout semantics must match retained FreeRTOS behavior.
surfaces.safe_facade: Typed queue facade that encodes item type, context, and timeout policy.
surfaces.test_or_static_check: rust-host-test can cover typed ownership rules; scheduler wakeup behavior remains simulator-flow and hardware-smoke.

surfaces.raw_operation: Starts, stops, resets, and dispatches FreeRTOS timers through retained runtime wrappers.
surfaces.invariant: Timer callbacks must be bounded, scheduler-context safe, and preserve retained timeout and command-queue behavior.
surfaces.safe_facade: Timer facade that constrains callback capabilities and maps durations to FreeRTOS ticks explicitly.
surfaces.test_or_static_check: local manifest/static/Rust checks cover tick conversion and callback type restrictions; scheduler timing remains simulator-flow.

surfaces.raw_operation: Locks and unlocks retained mutexes implemented by src/freertos/mutex.cpp with task readiness context from include/tasks.hpp and src/common/tasks.cpp.
surfaces.invariant: Mutex ownership must be paired, non-recursive or recursive according to retained wrapper policy, and not held across ISR-only or fatal-only paths; related synchronization evidence includes src/freertos/binary_semaphore.cpp, src/freertos/counting_semaphore.cpp, and src/freertos/wait_condition.cpp.
surfaces.safe_facade: Synchronization facade with RAII guards and explicit scheduler-context constraints.
surfaces.test_or_static_check: rust-host-test can prove guard pairing; mutex timing and priority behavior require simulator-flow or manual-hardware-required evidence.

surfaces.raw_operation: Gives and takes binary semaphores from retained src/freertos/binary_semaphore.cpp with TaskDeps references in include/tasks.hpp and src/common/tasks.cpp.
surfaces.invariant: Binary semaphore state must remain single-token, context-correct for ISR/task calls, and compatible with related retained synchronization wrappers src/freertos/mutex.cpp, src/freertos/counting_semaphore.cpp, and src/freertos/wait_condition.cpp.
surfaces.safe_facade: Synchronization facade with binary-token ownership and context-specific give/take APIs.
surfaces.test_or_static_check: rust-host-test can cover token transitions; semaphore wakeup timing remains simulator-flow or manual-hardware-required evidence.

surfaces.raw_operation: Gives and takes counting semaphores from retained src/freertos/counting_semaphore.cpp with TaskDeps references in include/tasks.hpp and src/common/tasks.cpp.
surfaces.invariant: Counting semaphore capacity must not overflow, take operations must reflect retained timeout behavior, and related wrappers src/freertos/mutex.cpp, src/freertos/binary_semaphore.cpp, and src/freertos/wait_condition.cpp remain the reference implementation.
surfaces.safe_facade: Synchronization facade with capacity-checked counting tokens.
surfaces.test_or_static_check: rust-host-test can cover capacity transitions; semaphore wakeup timing remains simulator-flow or manual-hardware-required evidence.

surfaces.raw_operation: Sets, clears, and waits on FreeRTOS event-group bits used with retained task and synchronization wrappers.
surfaces.invariant: Event bits must be typed, mask-bounded, and ordered consistently with retained wait conditions in src/freertos/wait_condition.cpp plus TaskDeps in include/tasks.hpp and src/common/tasks.cpp; related wrappers include src/freertos/mutex.cpp, src/freertos/binary_semaphore.cpp, and src/freertos/counting_semaphore.cpp.
surfaces.safe_facade: Synchronization facade with typed event masks and explicit wait-all/wait-any semantics.
surfaces.test_or_static_check: rust-host-test can cover mask rules; event-group ordering and scheduler wakeups require simulator-flow or manual-hardware-required evidence.

surfaces.raw_operation: Waits and notifies through retained src/freertos/wait_condition.cpp with related synchronization wrappers and TaskDeps readiness.
surfaces.invariant: Wait conditions must pair predicate checks with waits, avoid lost wakeups, and preserve timeout behavior across src/freertos/mutex.cpp, src/freertos/binary_semaphore.cpp, src/freertos/counting_semaphore.cpp, include/tasks.hpp, and src/common/tasks.cpp.
surfaces.safe_facade: Synchronization facade that requires predicate-checked waits and scoped notify handles.
surfaces.test_or_static_check: rust-host-test can cover predicate discipline; scheduler timing and lost-wakeup evidence require simulator-flow or manual-hardware-required validation.

surfaces.raw_operation: Feeds, arms, observes, or intentionally stops watchdog behavior at startup, task, panic, and fatal boundaries.
surfaces.invariant: Watchdog interaction must remain board-profile aware, must not mask deadlocks, and must preserve retained fatal/reset behavior.
surfaces.safe_facade: Watchdog boundary facade that exposes only board-approved feed/disable operations and records fatal-path behavior.
surfaces.test_or_static_check: local manifest/static/Rust checks can identify call ownership; watchdog timing and reset effects require hardware-smoke or manual-hardware-required evidence.
